chapters.title: OPEN
chapters.idea: A word becomes a video: the title and the claim 'a video is a file of data'

chapters.title: TYPE
chapters.idea: Kinetic typography: per-letter and per-word entrances, a counter, one line in Japanese

chapters.title: SHAPES
chapters.idea: Draw-on strokes, arcs and rings, gradients that move, a path that morphs, a wave of staggered shapes

chapters.title: SPACE
chapters.idea: 2.5D: cards in depth, a camera flight, depth of field with a rack focus

chapters.title: LIGHT
chapters.idea: A lamp across a dark room: lit cards, shadows on the wall, fog

chapters.title: BLEND AND MATTE
chapters.idea: Blend modes (light leaks), one matte shared by several layers, a luma matte

chapters.title: SHADER AND WARP
chapters.idea: Fragment shaders drawn by formula, a title bent like water

chapters.title: FILTERS AND PARTICLES
chapters.idea: Glow, CRT, glitch, film grain; a seeded particle burst

chapters.title: MOTION
chapters.idea: Springs, cubic-bezier easing, a time remap (slow, freeze, rewind), a seeded handheld shake

chapters.title: SOUND
chapters.idea: Sound is text too: the music of this reel as notation, sfx hits with matching visuals, visuals that follow the beat

chapters.title: DATA AND TALKS
chapters.idea: A chart that draws itself, a counter, a slide deck with stops

chapters.title: SOURCE
chapters.idea: This video's own data scrolling, the measured size, the install line, experimental / MIT
